title: Pan-Seared Duck Gyoza with Italian Twist
description: A fusion of Italian and Japanese flavors in this crispy pan-seared duck gyoza dish.

ingredients.name: gyoza wrappers
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Brush the gyoza wrappers with sesame oil on both sides.
Place a duck breast strip in the center of each wrapper.
Add a few slices of onion and a sprinkle of garlic on top of the duck.
Fold the wrapper in half to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Heat 1-2 tbsp of olive oil in the preheated skillet and add the gyoza, seam-side down.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the gyoza over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Serve hot with parmesan cheese sprinkled on top.
Optional: Serve with a side of marinara sauce or a simple green salad.
